title: Authentication Discussion
transcript: The team discussed authentication options. Firebase Authentication was rejected because of vendor lock-in concerns. JWT authentication with refresh tokens was selected as the final solution.

title: Database Selection
transcript: The engineering team compared PostgreSQL and MongoDB. MongoDB was selected because the application requires flexible document structures and faster development.

title: Frontend Redesign
transcript: Marwan will redesign the dashboard before next Friday. The team agreed to use a modern card-based layout and improve navigation.

title: Sprint Planning
transcript: The sprint will focus on API integration, authentication implementation, and dashboard improvements. Ahmed is responsible for API integration.

title: API Architecture
transcript: The team discussed REST and GraphQL. REST APIs were selected because they are simpler for the first release of SmartMeet.
